{{RV|type=command

|game1= argo
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= Argo

|descr= Get the client's current Cloud service login status.

|s1= [[getLoginStatus]]

|r1= [[Number]] - can be one of:
* &nbsp;0: Not logged in
* &nbsp;1: Logged in with a {{Name|bi}} account
* &nbsp;2: Logged in as guest
* -1: Internal error

|x1= <sqf>
switch (getLoginStatus) do
{
	case 0:		{ hint "Not logged" };
	case 1:		{ hint "You are BI-approved, gooooood" };
	case 2:		{ hint "Logged in as a Guest? 2, target that man!" };
	case -1:	{ hint "Something went wrong" };
};
</sqf>

|seealso= [[getClientState]] [[getClientStateNumber]]
}}
